title: Clarify review-ready reporting language
summary: Add a reusable reporting check that distinguishes delivered evidence from human-completed disposition.

operations.content: Before saying completed, verify the machine state is completed and human-review evidence is passed. Describe review-ready as awaiting human disposition.
operations.rationale: Repeated usage evidence shows review-ready language being overstated.

expected_outcomes: No false completion claims on review-ready goals
Fewer user corrections to status language
